source.provider: Supabase QA Postgres through connected service, SELECT only

reproduce.sql:
select
 (select c.relrowsecurity and c.relforcerowsecurity from pg_class c where c.oid='public.evidence_items'::regclass) as evidence_rls_force,
 (select c.relrowsecurity and c.relforcerowsecurity from pg_class c where c.oid='public.evidence_item_audit_events'::regclass) as audit_rls_force,
 (select count(*) from pg_trigger t where t.tgrelid='public.evidence_items'::regclass and not t.tgisinternal and t.tgenabled='O') as enabled_vault_triggers,
 (select count(*) from pg_policies p where p.schemaname='storage' and p.tablename='objects' and p.policyname in ('rls_compliance_evidence_objects_insert_organization','rls_compliance_evidence_objects_select_organization')) as canonical_storage_policies,
 (select coalesce(bool_or(public=false),false) from storage.buckets where id='compliance-evidence') as evidence_private_bucket,
 (select count(*) from pg_constraint where conrelid='public.evidence_items'::regclass and conname in ('evidence_items_attachment_completeness_check','evidence_items_storage_path_contract_check','evidence_items_file_sha256_check')) as attachment_constraints,
 (select not has_table_privilege('anon','public.evidence_items','SELECT') and not has_table_privilege('anon','public.evidence_items','INSERT') and not has_table_privilege('anon','public.evidence_items','UPDATE')) as anonymous_no_vault_access,
 (select not has_table_privilege('authenticated','public.evidence_items','DELETE')) as authenticated_no_delete,
 (select count(*) from storage.objects where bucket_id='compliance-evidence') as qa_objects,
 (select count(*) from public.evidence_items) as qa_items;
reproduce.note: Read-only query; reviewer must independently run and attest with exact QA project.
